items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter states a separate posting date: 'zur Post gegeben am 02.01.2026', which controls over the printed Bescheid date. Per the letter's own rule and the statutory PostModG rule for letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting, counting the posting day itself as day 0: 02.01. (0) → 03.01. (1) → 04.01. (2) → 05.01. (3) → 06.01.2026 (4). 06.01.2026 (Heilige Drei Könige/Epiphany) is a statutory public holiday in Bayern, where this Finanzamt sits. Because this is a tax office, § 108 Abs. 3 AO moves the deemed delivery day to the next working day: Mittwoch, 07.01.2026. The one-month Einspruch period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO then runs from that delivery day to the same day number in the following month (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 07.01.2026 + 1 month = 07.02.2026. 07.02.2026 is a Saturday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the period end moves to the next working day: Sonntag 08.02.2026 is also non-working, so the deadline moves to Montag, 09.02.2026.
